name: Federico Bisiacchi
abstract_title: DNA RESONANCE AND THE SUPERRADIANT COLLAPSE OF QUALIA: A FRACTAL MODEL OF CONSCIOUSNESS
abstract: DNA RESONANCE AND THE SUPERRADIANT COLLAPSE OF QUALIA: A FRACTAL MODEL OF CONSCIOUSNESS We present a falsifiable, quantum-informed framework of layered architecture of Reality in which DNA is not merely a genetic archive but a vibrational filter that individualizes Qualia, the irreducible units of conscious experience. DNA operates as a dynamic resonance system, interacting with environmental and internal stimuli through: -epigenetic modulation -quantum coherence in neuronal microtubules -cohere
field: Consciousness studies / DNA as fractal antenna / epigenetics
notable: Author of 'L'uomo, prisma biologico'; developed FRARE model
notes: Career in corporate world before turning to consciousness studies. Published preprint on DNA as fractal antenna. No formal academic affiliation found.
